author: codex
scope: Wider research registry, not an active-parameter list. Includes historical bounds, protocol grids and variant values. Request descriptions, unit labels, classifications, and notes are in English. Inferred units remain provisional. No contact or correspondence fields.

groups.title: Electrical properties and soma–neurite geometry
groups.requested_measurements: Healthy human iPSC-derived motor-neuron reconstructions with lengths, diameters and accessible volumes; matched soma/axon voltage recordings, capacitance, conductance, axon initial segment properties, local sodium and response delays.
groups.interpretation_limit: Historical fit bounds are not measured human physiological intervals. Nine firing conditions do not uniquely determine geometry.

groups.title: ADAR2, GluA2/AMPA and calcium buffering
groups.requested_measurements: GluA2 Q/R editing counts, surface AMPA subunits and currents paired with calibrated calcium time courses, resting calcium, indicator loading and added buffer, stimulation and washout.
groups.interpretation_limit: Calcium decay alone cannot separate buffer capacity from extrusion. Measurements from the same cell line are not necessarily paired measurements from the same cell.

groups.title: PMCA2 abundance, turnover and regulation
groups.requested_measurements: Isoform-resolved active surface-pump counts or density, accessible volume, calcium/calmodulin and PIP2 conditions, PMCA-specific calcium flux and ATP cost during load, pause and repeat stimulation.
groups.interpretation_limit: Density, active fraction and turnover can compensate for one another. Measurements in Jurkat, Sf9 or CHO cells are not human motor-neuron calibration.

groups.title: Spatial calcium/ATP exchange and pump delivery
groups.requested_measurements: Paired soma/neurite calcium and ATP traces with compartment volumes; effective exchange; PMCA2-specific cargo numbers, transport speeds, pauses, insertion, retrieval and energy cost.
groups.interpretation_limit: Lysosomal transport speed does not identify PMCA2 transport. Short and long neurites require separate geometry and exchange accounting.

groups.title: ATP supply and competing consumption
groups.requested_measurements: ATP, ADP, AMP and free MgATP during rest, load and recovery; respiration, glycolysis, oxygen/glucose conditions and calcium-pump fluxes; protein maintenance and transport costs.
groups.interpretation_limit: Stoichiometry does not determine total flux. An unknown cost is not zero; normalized respiration is not an absolute ATP-production flux.

groups.title: Calpain, calpastatin and substrate cleavage
groups.requested_measurements: Paired calcium and CAPN1/2 activity time courses, calpastatin and autolysis, washout/rechallenge, intact TDP-43 and spectrin products by compartment, with synthesis/clearance controls.
groups.interpretation_limit: Accumulated FRET cleavage is not instantaneous enzyme activity. Local substrate cleavage does not directly measure nuclear TDP-43 function.

groups.title: TDP-43 pools, synthesis, transport and aggregation
groups.requested_measurements: Absolute nuclear/cytoplasmic TDP-43 pools, TARDBP RNA/NMD, independent synthesis and pulse-chase turnover, import/export, and soluble/insoluble forms with epitope and survival controls.
groups.interpretation_limit: Exogenous aggregates, endogenous intact protein and cleavage fragments require distinct interpretation; cell division or selective survival can bias turnover estimates.

groups.title: Nuclear TDP-43, STMN2 and regrowth
groups.requested_measurements: Matched nuclear TDP-43, canonical/cryptic STMN2 RNA, soma/axon protein, perturbation/rescue and regrowth measurements; independent neuromuscular-junction function.
groups.interpretation_limit: Regrowth is not NMJ function. Mouse and primate STMN2 regulation cannot be treated as interchangeable.

groups.title: ER calcium, SOCE and calcium-activated potassium currents
groups.requested_measurements: Matched ER/cytosolic calcium, voltage and ATP; ER volume/loading, SERCA, release/leak, store-operated currents and SK/BK recordings with calibrated indicators and buffers.
groups.interpretation_limit: Relative fluorescence or caffeine responses alone do not determine absolute buffering or a universal SK activation threshold.

groups.title: Iron, ferritinophagy, lysosomes and GPX4
groups.requested_measurements: Compartment-resolved total iron and labile Fe2+, ferritin iron/protein, NCOA4/HERC2 turnover, lysosomal pH/TRPML1, GPX4 activity, GSH/GSSG and lipid-oxidation time courses.
groups.interpretation_limit: Total elemental iron is not the labile pool; protein abundance is not enzymatic activity. Preserve soma, axon and lysosome distinctions.

groups.title: PKN1 and secretory/Golgi proteostasis
groups.requested_measurements: PKN1 activity and isoform-specific function, Rab1/ERGIC/Golgi transit times, cargo transport, autophagic flux, clearance and ATP cost under controlled perturbations.
groups.interpretation_limit: Several couplings are hypotheses, including the possibility of no effect. Normalized gains are not measured kinetic rates.

groups.title: RNA-to-functional KCNQ2 and ATP2B2 protein
groups.requested_measurements: Correctly spliced RNA, total and surface protein, M-current or PMCA flux, turnover, delivery pauses and local translation in matched samples, including rescue.
groups.interpretation_limit: An RNA fold change cannot be substituted for a conductance or pump-flux fold change.

groups.title: Observers, protocols and unclassified numerical entries
groups.requested_measurements: Help identify the biological quantity, units and calibration behind unresolved entries, and distinguish biological parameters from stimulation, solver, fitting and observation settings.
groups.interpretation_limit: Not every number is a missing biological measurement. Protocol grids and numerical tolerances should not be calibrated as physiological ranges.

groups.title: Na/K pump, NCX and ionic cost of firing
groups.requested_measurements: Matched intracellular sodium, extracellular potassium, voltage and ATP; pump current, surface alpha1/alpha3, beta and FXYD composition; sodium/calcium exchange and recovery after defined loads.
groups.interpretation_limit: Isoform fractions and affinity/Hill parameters from other systems do not establish healthy human motor-neuron values.

groups.title: Mitochondrial calcium and energy coupling
groups.requested_measurements: Calibrated cytosolic/matrix calcium, matrix volume and buffering, MCU influx/efflux, matrix sodium, membrane potential, ATP/ADP and respiration during load/recovery.
groups.interpretation_limit: A dimensionless energy variable is not membrane potential. Transport capacity, kinetics and effective costs remain conditional.

groups.title: Absolute TDP-43/protein turnover and energy cost
groups.requested_measurements: Compartment- and form-resolved protein amounts, proteasomal/lysosomal clearance fractions at defined MgATP/ADP/Pi, pulse-chase data, ubiquitin/chaperone overhead and substrate-specific ATP cost.
groups.interpretation_limit: ATP costs for purified systems or other substrates cannot be assigned directly to human TDP-43 degradation; scenario costs are not measurements.

groups.title: Motor-terminal energetics and NMJ transmission
groups.requested_measurements: Terminal action potentials/calcium, quantal release, endplate potentials, muscle action potentials, readily releasable pool, ATP, terminal volume, rundown/recovery and contraction.
groups.interpretation_limit: Release or a passive endplate response is not muscle force; downstream functional coupling remains incomplete.

groups.title: Receptors, FXYD7 and CaV1.2 turnover
groups.requested_measurements: Matched RNA and functional protein, GABA/NMDA currents and reversal potentials, calcium, FXYD occupancy and pump affinity; surface CaV1.2 insertion/removal pulse-chase and currents.
groups.interpretation_limit: RNA abundance does not determine functional surface protein. Insertion, degradation and channel activity must be distinguished.

groups.title: Nuclear TDP-43, RNA processing/export and translation
groups.requested_measurements: Volume-aware live nuclear/cytoplasmic import/export, RNA metabolic labeling/decay, calibrated RNA-seq and ribosome profiling, absolute protein synthesis/turnover in healthy motor neurons.
groups.interpretation_limit: Elongation estimates from HEK cells and cycloheximide-based motor-neuron measurements have different applicability and biases.

groups.title: Stages of the ribosome cycle
groups.requested_measurements: Absolute 40S/60S/80S occupancy, joining/recycling, eligible stalls, rescue times, active-ribosome abundance, protein flux and ATP/GTP use.
groups.interpretation_limit: A mechanism established in a reconstituted system does not supply its rate in a human motor neuron.

groups.title: Ribosome biogenesis and nascent-chain energetics
groups.requested_measurements: Active ribosome abundance and protein flux, rRNA pulse-chase/processing/export/turnover, stalled 80S/60S and nascent-chain pools, orphan clearance and energy costs.
groups.interpretation_limit: New stage rates, capacities and effective energy costs are scenario parameters until independently constrained.

groups.title: Shared translation resources for ribosomal proteins, KCNQ2 and PKN1
groups.requested_measurements: Absolute subunit, KCNQ2 and PKN1 abundance/synthesis/turnover, ribosomal-protein stoichiometry, assembly, amino-acid, tRNA and ATP/GTP use.
groups.interpretation_limit: Known sequence lengths constrain material accounting but do not identify synthesis rates or competition between transcripts.

groups.title: Amino acids, tRNA charging and nucleotide energy
groups.requested_measurements: Free amino acids, charged/uncharged tRNAs, ATP/ADP/GTP/GDP and synthesis during deprivation/recovery, plus amino-acid return from mature-protein turnover.
groups.interpretation_limit: Balance-derived NDPK flux is not an independent measurement. Pooled substrates and charging parameters are approximations.

groups.title: Lysosomal amino-acid export and stress feedback
groups.requested_measurements: Labeled protein turnover, cytosolic/lysosomal amino-acid pulse-chase, charged tRNAs, ATP/GTP, phospho-eIF2alpha, ATF4, GADD34, rRNA and protein synthesis through deprivation/recovery.
groups.interpretation_limit: Normalized stress readouts are not absolute molecular pools; selected residues do not represent every amino acid.

groups.title: PERK versus GCN2, ATF4 and GADD34
groups.requested_measurements: Matched ER stress versus amino-acid withdrawal, washout/rechallenge, phospho-PERK/GCN2/eIF2alpha, absolute ATF4/GADD34 RNA and translation, ATP, amino acids and charged tRNA, including GADD34 loss.
groups.interpretation_limit: Human motor-neuron kinetic rates remain unresolved. Sequence length is not a kinetic measurement.

groups.title: Ribosomal-subunit maturation and delivery
groups.requested_measurements: Soma/neurite precursor and mature-subunit pulse-chase, delivery/return, local synthesis, ribosomal-protein exchange and ATP/GTP costs.
groups.interpretation_limit: Assembly of a new subunit and protein exchange within an existing mature particle are different processes.

groups.title: Local translation with finite resources
groups.requested_measurements: Absolute local mRNA, translating ribosomes, completed proteins and turnover; amino acids, tRNA and ATP/GTP; local volume/exchange during inhibition, washout and repeat load.
groups.interpretation_limit: Protein production, transport, local translation and degradation must be separated rather than inferred from one endpoint.

groups.title: GAP43 RNA delivery
groups.requested_measurements: Free/bound GAP43 RNA in soma/axon, transit-time distributions, decay, local protein pulse-chase and ATP/GTP use.
groups.interpretation_limit: RNA localization alone does not quantify local synthesis; transported protein and newly translated protein need independent labels.

groups.title: Local GAP43 function and axon regrowth
groups.requested_measurements: Local RNA, nascent/total/phosphorylated GAP43, ATP, axon length and growth speed after injury, with knockdown and localized versus soma-retained rescue across donors.
groups.interpretation_limit: A normalized growth readout is not physical growth, its ATP cost or NMJ repair.

groups.title: GAP43-dependent initiation versus extension
groups.requested_measurements: Time-lapse initiation latency/frequency, elongation conditional on initiation, local RNA/protein/ATP and independent NMJ outcomes.
groups.interpretation_limit: An endpoint population mean cannot identify initiation probability separately from subsequent elongation speed.

groups.title: Local ribosome-associated quality control
groups.requested_measurements: Stalled 80S and 60S–nascent-chain complexes, free subunits, RNA fate, chain release/proteolysis, amino-acid return and ATP/GTP under stress and washout.
groups.interpretation_limit: The selected eligible-stall pathway does not cover every no-go-decay, CAT-tail or tRNA-repair process.

groups.title: Ribosomal-protein exchange and ribosome retirement
groups.requested_measurements: Compartment-resolved pulse-SILAC of free and ribosome-bound RPS26/other proteins, intact subunits, rRNA degradation/export and energy use during stress/washout.
groups.interpretation_limit: Whole-cell protein turnover cannot identify exchange and whole-particle retirement separately.

groups.title: Ribosome maintenance, production and transport
groups.requested_measurements: Matched pre-rRNA, mature/free subunits, free/bound new ribosomal proteins, transport, ATP/GTP and amino acids with baseline/stress/recovery labeling.
groups.interpretation_limit: Demand-derived supply feedback is a modeling assumption, not a measured steady state.

groups.title: Precursor surveillance and sequence-specific protein costs
groups.requested_measurements: Free/nuclear/assembled ribosomal-protein and pre-rRNA pulse-chase under assembly arrest/recovery; absolute ATP/GTP/amino acids and ubiquitin/FUBI coproduct fate.
groups.interpretation_limit: Sequence lengths constrain accounting, but do not establish human assembly stoichiometry or effective surveillance costs.

groups.title: Precursor quality and selective removal
groups.requested_measurements: Normal/aberrant precursor RNA, free/bound proteins, marking, clearance and mature output with ATP/amino-acid measurements; distinguish assembly delay from injury.
groups.interpretation_limit: Recognition and damage rates are effective hypotheses, not measured human quality-classification rates.

groups.title: rRNA degradation and nucleotide salvage
groups.requested_measurements: Isotope-labeled RNA fragments, nuclear/lysosomal nucleosides, cytosolic NMP/NTP, new RNA, ATP/ADP, volumes and medium loss; RNASET2, transporter and kinase perturbations.
groups.interpretation_limit: Pooling nucleotide bases and routing nuclear NMP or lysosomal nucleosides are model assumptions requiring discrimination.

groups.title: GAP43 codons, collisions and tRNA repair
groups.requested_measurements: Local amino acids/nucleotides and volumes, charged/modified tRNA, initiation/runoff, disomes, CCA/cyclic-phosphate repair, ELAC1/TRNT1/ANKZF1 perturbation and nascent protein.
groups.interpretation_limit: The detailed branch is not a codon-level model of every protein; its structural approximations remain relevant.

groups.title: Shared codon-level resources
groups.requested_measurements: Local amino acids and charged tRNAs, GAP43 polysomes/synthesis, ELAC1/TRNT1/RQC, ATP/GTP/CTP and exchange with the soma.
groups.interpretation_limit: Mean-field dynamics are not a finite-copy stochastic simulation; other proteins remain pooled.

groups.title: Individual ribosomal-protein turnover and pool allocation
groups.requested_measurements: Human motor-neuron peptide assignments, biological replicates, precursor enrichment, free/nucleolar/assembled protein pulse-chase, intact-subunit stoichiometry, RNA scaffolds and ATP/amino acids.
groups.interpretation_limit: Rounded whole-cell turnover anchors for 75 proteins do not define free-pool rates; exceptions and missing measurements must remain explicit.

groups.title: TDP-43 nuclear transport and Ran energetics
groups.requested_measurements: Matched nuclear/cytoplasmic volumes, free/bound TDP-43, KPNA/KPNB1/CAS/NTF2 pools, import/export, RanGTP/GDP, GTP/GDP/ATP/ADP and pore permeability under perturbation/recovery.
groups.interpretation_limit: A selected-cargo transport model does not represent all nuclear traffic; absolute pools and rates need matched constraints.

groups.title: RNA, protein and preribosome nuclear transport
groups.requested_measurements: Matched absolute pools, volumes, fraction yields/spike-ins, RNA metabolic labeling, export/import, ribosomal-protein receptors, XPO1 stoichiometry, ATP/GTP and Ran perturbations.
groups.interpretation_limit: A 111-gene TPM inventory does not provide transport rates, and an initial pool does not establish steady state.

groups.title: Individual ribosomal-protein mRNA synthesis and decay
groups.requested_measurements: Matched 4sU/SLAM/RATE data with biological replicates, molecules per cell, volumes/spike-ins, nuclear/cytoplasmic flow, decay, isoforms/readthrough and gene-specific production costs.
groups.interpretation_limit: Neuron and K562 loss priors and relative production shapes do not set absolute human motor-neuron production or compartment-specific loss.

groups.title: PMCA proton equivalents, Na/H exchange and pH recovery
groups.requested_measurements: Calcium export paired with calibrated pH and sodium during load/recovery, buffering capacity, Na/H inhibition, bicarbonate conditions, medium composition and temperature in the same healthy human motor neurons.
groups.interpretation_limit: The optional acid-removal module is conditional. The 2 H/Ca reference is from snail neurons; recovery times are scenarios. pH/buffer settings describe an observer, not channel or RHS feedback.
